## Expected and actual behaviour
What should happen? What happened instead?
### Answer:

## Steps to reproduce
List the steps. If it happens only sometimes, say how often.
### Answer:
> (Please provide a step-by-step description of how to reproduce the issue. Include any specific conditions or settings that may be relevant. If the issue is intermittent, please indicate how frequently it occurs.))

## Environment
List the app version, Windows version, display scale, camera and driver. Include the capture app if you used one.
### Answer:
> (Please provide details about the environment in which the issue occurred. This may include the version of the application, the operating system and its version, display settings, camera model and driver version, and any capture applications used. This information can help us identify potential causes of the issue.)

## Evidence
Attach a screenshot or error text. Remove personal information first.
### Answer:
> (Please attach any relevant evidence that can help us understand the issue. This may include screenshots, error messages, or logs. Ensure that any personal information is removed before sharing.)

## Include files
It might help if you attach relevant files:
- Screenshot of the issue.
- Profile settings (\USERS\[USER]\AppData\Local\CameraPressets\profiles.json).
- Window settings (\USERS\[USER]\AppData\Local\CameraPressets\window.json).
- Log files from log folder (\USERS\[USER]\AppData\Local\CameraPressets\Logs\)
- Any other files that can help reproduce the issue.
